summary: Every administrator your provider publishes now reaches the managed tenant, whatever their name looks like.

new.title: Copy a setting between tenants
new.text: A new setup script copies a setting, such as naming conventions or a schedule, to another tenant. It backs up the target first and refuses tenant-specific settings.

fixes.title: Admins are no longer withheld by name
fixes.text: A managed tenant's naming setting could silently drop published administrators. Every published admin is now sent, and a naming mismatch is only reported.

fixes.title: Sent administrators are managed normally
fixes.text: The engine now recognises centrally sent administrators whatever they are called, so they are managed like any other and never recreated in a loop.

fixes.title: Pull results shown on Job schedule
fixes.text: The explanation of each pull, such as how many administrators were sent or excluded, is now kept and shown on Job schedule.
